scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build:api: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build:release
scripts.bundle:production: pnpm run build:api && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run bundle-package
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test:field-training:phase: pnpm run typecheck:field-training:tests && TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=$PWD/artifacts/field-training/tsconfig.test.json pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts exec tsx --test ../artifacts/field-training/src/lib/phase-configuration.test.ts ../artifacts/field-training/src/lib/phase-extension.test.ts ../artifacts/field-training/src/lib/training-calendar.test.ts
scripts.test:field-training:regressions: pnpm run test:field-training:phase && TZ=America/New_York TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=$PWD/artifacts/field-training/tsconfig.test.json pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts exec tsx --test ../artifacts/field-training/src/lib/offlineStorage.test.ts ../artifacts/field-training/src/lib/dispatch-prefill.test.ts
scripts.test:training-packets: pnpm run typecheck:field-training:tests && TZ=America/New_York TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=$PWD/artifacts/field-training/tsconfig.test.json pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts exec tsx --test ../artifacts/field-training/src/lib/training-packet-sync.test.ts ../artifacts/field-training/src/lib/packet-history.test.ts ../artifacts/field-training/src/lib/workspace-draft-sync.test.ts ../artifacts/field-training/src/lib/workspace-sync-editor.test.ts ../artifacts/field-training/src/lib/protected-packets.test.ts ../artifacts/field-training/src/lib/packet-upload-controls.test.ts ../artifacts/field-training/src/lib/launch-readiness.test.ts && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts exec tsx --test ../artifacts/api-server/tests/launch-readiness.test.ts && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts exec tsx --test ../artifacts/mockup-sandbox/src/components/mockups/packet-upload/DraftFinalizationPreview.test.ts
scripts.test:maintenance-guardrails: pnpm run typecheck:field-training:tests && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts exec tsx --test src/snapshot-context.test.ts src/write-context.test.ts && TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=$PWD/artifacts/field-training/tsconfig.test.json pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts exec tsx --test ../artifacts/field-training/src/lib/packet-upload-controls.test.ts ../artifacts/field-training/src/lib/weekly-log-print.test.ts ../artifacts/field-training/src/lib/print-export-guardrails.test.ts
